meta.summary: Strict AI spend policy for a 501-2000 person manufacturer at experimenting maturity, envelopes set at 0.5x sector median to govern early adoption.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable; all AI subscriptions must be procured through the approved vendor portal with Finance sign-off before activation.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 70% of monthly allocation
Team envelope reaches 90% of monthly allocation or any single session exceeds $20/hr
Team envelope is exhausted or company envelope reaches 95% before month end

rationales.e1: Production inference for the support-triage service at $211/day runs under the Operations team envelope and is classified COGS under the production environment rule; no action required.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings at $38 fall within the Data team envelope of $400/month and meet the efficient-tier routing requirement; transaction passes without intervention.
rationales.e3: The Search team cost per request spiked 96% overnight, breaching the 20% variance band; likely cause is a prompt-length regression or model version change introduced in the deploy, triggering a step-1 alert to the Engineering lead for root-cause review.
rationales.e4: This is the third ChatGPT Team subscription on the Marketing employee card this quarter, meeting the team_subscription_threshold of 1 duplicate; the charge is rerouted to the approved vendor portal and the employee is notified that personal-card AI purchases are not reimbursable.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $1,000 fine_tune_over_usd threshold and requires CFO approval before the job is queued; the checklist UI will collect data classification, model ownership, and cost justification.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 10-retry limit, and its $47/hr burn rate exceeded the $20/hr kill threshold; the agent was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled spend.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is within the 24-hour approval window and the $100 max_delta_usd cap; routed to CFO for same-day sign-off, approved conditionally on the demo scope.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key running at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers step-2 throttle under the response ladder; Engineering lead is notified within 2 hours to attribute the spend or the key is suspended.
rationales.e9: Agent card charge of 499 against a 250 ceiling. Approval required.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/month duplicates a Sales-owned tool with 40% seat utilization and an existing $1,400/year contract; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider charged 120; the new-provider rule is set to block. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to an internal tool was misclassified as COGS; the internal-tool project tag rule overrides the environment default and reclassifies the spend to OpEx, correcting the general ledger entry.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 70% burn_alert_pct threshold; the CFO and Engineering lead are notified and non-critical workloads are throttled to preserve runway through month end.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes, classification rules, and agent guardrails are within policy parameters and no carry-forward exceptions are open.
